nom: SUNGBOON EDITOR Apple Peel Syrup Coating Glow Skin Pad

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin (dry in winter, oily in summer) used the pads year-round without issue and noted less irritation.
segments.dry: A reviewer who described her skin as dry in winter found the pads hydrating and non-irritating.
segments.oily: A reviewer who described her skin as oily in summer reported no issues using the pads through that season.

concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe the pads as very moisturizing and long-lasting on skin, with one noting the pad stays moist even after half use and another saying it kept skin hydrated all day under makeup.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin reported less irritation and more plumpness after consistent use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer said the pads lightened some spots she was concerned about.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone skin used the product consistently without breakouts or irritation; no other reviewer mentions acne outcomes.
concerns.aging: One reviewer noted increased plumpness, especially on the cheeks, after consistent use.

extraits.texte: Im really happy with this product For reference my skin is somewhat sensitive, acne prone, dry in the winter and oily in the summer. I have used this product all year round without an issue. After using the pads consistently (5 times a week) these are the improvements I could observe; decrease in skin texture, more hydrated skin, less irritation, and an increase in the plumpness of my skin, especially on my cheeks. These pads really made my skin look nice. Now I will warn you about a few potential downsides i noticed about these pads. Depending on your preferences, these pads are HUGEEE AND THICK!! And absolutely SOAKED in serum. I think the claim is that they usually have a full bottle's worth in the jar but it feels like a single cotton pad alone has enough juice to cover your whole face, neck, chest, and arms!! With that being said, its sort of time consuming with how much product is loaded on this thing, it takes longer for your skin to absorb it all than other toner pads. I get impatient sometimes and squeeze the remaining serum and start patting my face. This product goes on sale somewhat often, and when it does I suggest you to try it out! These are some really solid toner/serum pads. I purchased a few months ago back in the summer and now I brought me a second jar. My skin really likes this formula! The before and after pics on the product is also somewhat accurate to the results I noticed in my skin however, I wouldn't vouch for that simce everyone has different skin

Love this product! got in on sale to try since I have not used this brand before, I added this into my skincare routine and when I say I see the difference! it really has smoothed out my skin and even lighten some spot I've been concerned about. be warned though it is SUPER slippery and doesn't feel like other exfoliating pads.

extraits.titre: Makeup-Proof Moisture That Lasts All Day
extraits.texte: It's really moisturizing, and if you put it on in the morning before putting on your makeup, your makeup won't flake all day long! And it's nice that it's larger than other pads.
I really like the smooth, glossy pad. It removes dead skin cells and the pad size is large, so it's perfect for someone like me with a big face. I really like it.

extraits.titre: Good Deal but Wished for More Sheets
extraits.texte: I bought it for less than 10,000 won, including the first purchase special price and payment benefits. It's an okay pad. But it's a shame it only contains 40 sheets.

extraits.titre: Moist, Large, and Doesn't Dry Out Fast
extraits.texte: Even though I used it more than halfway, it's still moist and dry. It's very easy to use~~ It doesn't dry out right away when you put it on. The size is very large and it is cool.
The moist Japchae smells good and it is so moisturizing that I am applying it every day!

reserve: All 12 reviews are 5-star and mostly brief, with only one review giving detailed skin-type and concern context, so segment- and concern-level conclusions rest on very limited evidence.
